# Runtime and infrastructure reference index

Start here; read only the local section or official page needed for the next decision. Shared authority is `/root/.agents/AGENTS.md`; task authority is its current STATE/TASK. Installed directory: `/root/.agents/runtime-references/` (plural). Do not create a singular alias, another loader, per-CLI instruction copies or a full-manual mirror. Source: agent-platform `content/runtime-references/`; installation and native consumption require separate verification.

## Local host contracts — on demand

- [runtime-bootstrap.md](runtime-bootstrap.md): unknown workspace/repository location.
- [codebase-orientation.md](codebase-orientation.md): bounded source/task orientation.
- [RUNTIME-LOADING.md](RUNTIME-LOADING.md): instruction discovery, context construction, resume and skill/tool loading differences.
- [CLI-LAUNCH.md](CLI-LAUNCH.md): native launch/resume/model/compaction surfaces; no launch authority.
- [runtime-wiring.md](runtime-wiring.md): per-CLI config owners, shared custom MCP registration, hooks and account boundaries.
- [global-runtime-routing.md](global-runtime-routing.md): concurrent writers, shared resources and handoffs.
- [HERDR-ORCHESTRATION.md](HERDR-ORCHESTRATION.md): authorized terminal/pane coordination.
- [CONTEXT-GOVERNANCE.md](CONTEXT-GOVERNANCE.md): short-term CLI/task state, durable Hindsight context, source/domain authority and correction protocol.
- [HINDSIGHT-RUNTIME.md](HINDSIGHT-RUNTIME.md): memory retrieval, retention, page refresh and installed API boundaries.
- [OFFICIAL-DOCS.md](OFFICIAL-DOCS.md): task-to-owner routing, bounded lookup and validation rules.
- [skills.md](skills.md): repository/custom versus vendor skill ownership.
- [runtime-core.v2.md](runtime-core.v2.md): approved shared core; not another startup include.

## Official CLI indexes

| Owner | Publisher index | Select within that index |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | https://code.claude.com/docs/llms.txt | CLI reference, memory, skills, MCP/tool search, settings, sub-agents |
| Muse Code | https://dev.meta.ai/llms.txt | Muse Code configuration, extending and native CLI pages; other Meta API pages are separate |
| Grok Build | https://docs.x.ai/llms.txt | Grok Build overview, CLI reference, project rules, settings and MCP; model API docs are separate |
| Codex | https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/llms.txt | Codex CLI, config reference, instructions, skills, plugins and hooks; distinguish other ChatGPT products |
| Antigravity CLI (`agy`) | https://antigravity.google/llms.txt | CLI use, customization discovery, rules, skills, hooks, settings and subagents |
| Anthropic API | https://docs.claude.com/llms.txt | API/tool-search protocol when the Claude Code page leaves a wire contract unresolved |

## Official infrastructure indexes

| Owner | Publisher index / primary documentation | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| Hostinger | https://www.hostinger.com/llms.txt ; https://www.hostinger.com/api/llms.txt ; https://www.hostinger.com/developers/llms.txt ; https://www.hostinger.com/docs/llms.txt ; https://docs.hostinger.com/llms.txt | Publisher root, API/MCP, developer and product documentation indexes; VPS API schema: https://developers.hostinger.com/openapi/openapi.json . Distinguish provider effects from guest/container operations |
| Docker | https://docs.docker.com/llms.txt | Engine, CLI, Compose, Dockerfile/build and API documentation selected through the index |
| Herdr | https://herdr.dev/llms.txt ; https://herdr.dev/agent-guide.md | Terminals, panes and native agent control; no domain authority or permanent model roles |
| Tailscale | https://tailscale.com/llms.txt → https://tailscale.com/docs/llms.txt | Network identity, connectivity, SSH and access policy; docs pages advertise Markdown forms |
| Hindsight | https://hindsight.vectorize.io/llms.txt | Memory server; API quickstart: https://hindsight.vectorize.io/developer/api/quickstart ; reference: https://hindsight.vectorize.io/api-reference . Compare installed OpenAPI/native integration before effects; the advertised `/sdks/mcp` leaf returned404 |

Use publisher-advertised child indexes, Markdown pages, OpenAPI/schema or focused CLI reference when relevant. An index is navigation, not a requirement to fetch all linked text. Read a publisher's full-text manual only for a selected unresolved topic with bounded extraction. Do not guess `llms-full.txt` or treat a redirect to an HTML homepage as an index. Hostinger API `https://developers.hostinger.com/llms.txt` returned404; use the root index/API documentation rather than repeatedly trying it. Tailscale `/kb/llms.txt` redirected to HTML; use `/docs/llms.txt`.

## Supporting native owners

These operations may appear in infrastructure tasks but belong to their own publishers, not the hosting provider or coding CLI. Use installed `--help`/man pages first for installed syntax. When an official LLM index is not verified, use the official reference directly; do not fabricate one.

- Model Context Protocol: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/llms.txt (protocol semantics; CLI configuration remains native-owned)
- OpenSSH: https://www.openssh.com/manual.html
- systemd: https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/
- Git: https://git-scm.com/docs ; GitHub CLI: https://cli.github.com/manual/
- Rust/Cargo: https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/ ; https://doc.rust-lang.org/rustc/
- Node.js: https://nodejs.org/api/ ; Bun: https://bun.sh/docs

Product boundaries and checked evidence live in [OFFICIAL-DOCS.md](OFFICIAL-DOCS.md). This set covers the named owners and current supporting boundaries, not every external service or future integration.
